sources.title: 大型強子對撞機概覽
sources.scope: 支援加速器、真空、低溫與探測器的系統概覽，以及 2008、2012 年歷史節點。

sources.title: 超導電磁鐵與束流導引

sources.title: 射頻共振腔與加速

sources.title: ATLAS 與大型強子對撞機導覽
sources.titleEn: Introduction to ATLAS and the Large Hadron Collider
sources.scope: 官方公眾導覽；ATLAS 是 LHC 的實驗偵測器之一，影片並非加速器操作程序。可用音軌依原播放器設定。
sources.scopeEn: Official public introduction. ATLAS is one LHC experiment; this is not accelerator operating procedure. Available audio tracks depend on player settings.

videos.title: ATLAS 與大型強子對撞機導覽
videos.titleEn: Introduction to ATLAS and the Large Hadron Collider
videos.scope: 官方公眾導覽；ATLAS 是 LHC 的實驗偵測器之一，影片並非加速器操作程序。可用音軌依原播放器設定。
videos.scopeEn: Official public introduction. ATLAS is one LHC experiment; this is not accelerator operating procedure. Available audio tracks depend on player settings.
watchFor: 區分粒子加速、碰撞、偵測與資料分析。
辨認偵測器層次如何提供不同證據。
觀察跨國團隊與資料流程的關係。
watchForEn: Separate acceleration, collision, detection and analysis.
Identify how detector layers provide different evidence.
Connect the international collaboration with data flows.
videos.before: 預畫一張束流與偵測器各司其職的系統圖。
videos.beforeEn: Sketch distinct beam and detector functions.
videos.after: 把一個粒子訊號追蹤到可供分析的紀錄。
videos.afterEn: Trace one detector signal into an analyzable record.
videos.playbackEvidence: Exact embed ID extracted from the official ATLAS introductory-video page; official channel verified with oEmbed.

courses.overview: 從「大型強子對撞機LHC」延伸到兩項可直接開啟的逐步課程；下列比較分別說明相似原理、差異與驗證練習，並附代表地點、地址或地理描述與近似座標。
courses.overviewEn: Extend Large Hadron Collider LHC into two directly accessible guided courses. Each comparison identifies shared principles, differences and verification exercises, with a representative location, address or geographical descriptor and approximate coordinates.

related.title: EMI早期電腦斷層掃描器工程
related.titleEn: EMI Early Computed Tomography Scanner Engineering
related.why: 把「大型強子對撞機LHC」與「EMI早期電腦斷層掃描器工程」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Large Hadron Collider LHC with EMI Early Computed Tomography Scanner Engineering: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.name: 倫敦科學博物館（典藏脈絡代表點）
place.coordinateScope: 公開代表定位點，座標為近似值；依地點可能是工程、園區、博物館、入口或城市，並非整體工程邊界。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate public reference point: a project, campus, museum, entrance or city depending on the entry, not the boundary of the entire project.

related.transfer: 大型探測和斷層量測都需要幾何校準、通道讀出、資料品質與重建驗證。
related.transferEn: Large detectors and tomography both require geometry calibration, channel readout, data quality and reconstruction checks.
related.difference: CT 重建物體衰減分布；LHC 實驗探測粒子碰撞事件，訊號來源和反演目標完全不同。
related.differenceEn: CT reconstructs attenuation within an object; LHC experiments measure collision events, with different signal sources and inverse problems.
practice: 畫出偵測器到資料的共同鏈
指出兩種重建想回答的不同問題
為一個失效通道設計品質標記
practiceEn: Design a quality flag for a failed channel

related.title: EXPLORER 全身正子影像系統
related.why: 把「大型強子對撞機LHC」與「EXPLORER 全身正子影像系統」對照，先辨認能沿用的原理，再檢查不能直接移植的設計條件。
related.whyEn: Compare Large Hadron Collider LHC with EXPLORER total-body PET imaging system: identify transferable principles, then check design conditions that cannot be transferred directly.

place.mapQuery: EXPLORER Molecular Imaging Center, 3195 Folsom Blvd Suite 120, Sacramento CA 95816
place.name: EXPLORER Molecular Imaging Center（EMIC）
place.address: 3195 Folsom Blvd, Suite #120, Sacramento, CA 95816, USA
place.addressEn: 3195 Folsom Blvd, Suite #120, Sacramento, CA 95816, USA
place.coordinateScope: 官方中心地址連結的建築代表點；不是 UC Davis 主校區、儀器室或病人所在地，不代表開放參訪。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Building point linked from the official center address; not the main UC Davis campus, scanner room or a patient location, and not a statement of public visitor access.

related.transfer: PET 與粒子實驗都依賴多通道偵測、時間資訊、事件篩選和校準資料。
related.transferEn: PET and particle experiments both use multichannel detection, timing information, event selection and calibration data.
related.difference: PET 符合事件用於醫學影像；LHC 碰撞事件包含多種粒子與探測層。本教學比較不是臨床掃描或放射操作指南。
related.differenceEn: PET coincidences support medical imaging; LHC collisions involve multiple particles and detector layers. This comparison is not a clinical scanning or radiation-operation guide.
practice: 比較兩個符合訊號與多粒子事件
標記時間偏差對資料的影響
用合成事件說明品質篩選
practiceEn: Compare paired coincidences with multiparticle events
Demonstrate quality selection with synthetic events

history.title: LHC 首次啟動
history.text: 九月十日的首次啟動是大型加速器整合史上的重要節點。
history.textEn: The first startup on 10 September marked an important milestone in integrating the large accelerator.

history.title: 希格斯粒子發現里程碑
history.text: ATLAS 與 CMS 的發現是加速器、探測器與分析共同工作的成果；本課不以示意資料重現該發現。
history.textEn: The ATLAS and CMS discovery resulted from combined accelerator, detector and analysis work; this lesson does not reproduce that discovery with illustrative data.
